title: NSGo game mod manifest (version 2)
description: ModManifest describes a mod. Mod authors write it as YAML in a [ManifestFile] (mod.yaml) in the mod's directory; [ParseManifest] reads it and [EncodeManifest] writes it.

manifestVersion.description: ManifestVersion is the schema version of the manifest file (1 or 2). A mod.yaml must state [MinManifestVersion] or [ManifestVersion]; a manifest built in code may leave it 0, and [EncodeManifest] writes [ManifestVersion].

id.description: ID uniquely identifies the mod, such as com.example.boss-rush.

name.description: Name is the mod's human-readable name.

version.description: Version is the mod's own semantic version, which dependency constraints are checked against.

author.description: Author optionally names the mod's author.

entry.description: Entry is the entry script's slash-separated path relative to the mod's directory. Required in manifestVersion 1; optional in manifestVersion 2 when contributes declares at least one content directory.

gameVersion.description: GameVersion optionally constrains the host game versions the mod runs on, such as ">=0.2.0".

capabilities.description: Capabilities lists the built-in game API capabilities the mod requests. In mod.yaml, the capabilities sequence may also contain dotted host capability names (<namespace>.<name>), which [ParseManifest] decodes into [ModManifest.HostCapabilities] and [EncodeManifest] writes after the built-in names in sorted order.

dependencies.description: Dependencies maps the IDs of mods this mod requires to version constraints.

optionalDependencies.description: OptionalDependencies maps the IDs of optional mods to version constraints (manifestVersion 2). When present, an optional dependency loads before this mod and its version must satisfy the constraint; when absent, it is ignored.

conflicts.description: Conflicts maps the IDs of incompatible mods to version constraints (manifestVersion 2). A conflicting pair is refused together in either direction.

platforms.description: Platforms lists the target platforms the mod runs on, such as [windows, macos, linux] (manifestVersion 2). When omitted, the mod runs on all platforms.

contributes.description: Contributes declares mod-relative content directories overlaid into [Manager.ContentFS] (manifestVersion 2).

ModContributes.description: ModContributes declares read-only content directories that a manifestVersion 2 mod overlays onto the host game via [Manager.ContentFS]. Each non-empty field is a slash-separated directory path relative to the mod's directory.

assets.description: Assets is the mod-relative directory of asset files (images, audio, fonts, models) overlaid under "assets/" in ContentFS.

scenes.description: Scenes is the mod-relative directory of scene files overlaid under "scenes/" in ContentFS.

l10n.description: L10n is the mod-relative directory of localization string tables overlaid under "l10n/" in ContentFS.

datatables.description: DataTables is the mod-relative directory of data tables overlaid under "datatables/" in ContentFS.
